meta.title: K3v | Live in Tokyo, Even Just for a Stay
meta.description: K3v is a hotel for staying in Tokyo the way you'd live there. Rooms where Japanese calm meets Nordic warmth, for an ordinary morning and one slightly special day.

hero.description: K3v is a place to stay in Tokyo as an extension of daily life, not a sightseeing base. In rooms layered with Japanese calm and Nordic warmth, the day begins with the smell of coffee, and ends with a single lamp switched off.
hero.illustrationAlt: Illustration of a room with a potted plant and a coffee cup by the window, overlooking the Tokyo skyline

pillars.title: A quiet floor plan
pillars.text: Light through shoji screens, the texture of wood, rooms that make room for empty space. We chose calm over spectacle.

pillars.title: Objects with a good hand-feel
pillars.text: The way Nordic furniture and textiles settle in the more you use them. Comfort like your own belongings, not hotel fixtures.

pillars.title: An extension of an ordinary morning
pillars.text: Less the tension of checking in, more the feeling of unlocking the door and saying 'I'm home' — time that continues your everyday life.

rooms.description: Each of the three rooms carries a different sense of how to live. Even within the same Tokyo, the room you choose shows you a slightly different face of the day.

items.name: ROOM 01
items.subtitle: The everyday room, wa meets Nordic
items.text: Our standard room layers solid-wood furniture and the scent of tatami with the softness of Nordic fabrics. A quiet that never grows tiresome, for those staying as if they lived here.
items.alt: Image of a room blending Japanese and Nordic design

items.name: ROOM 02
items.subtitle: Urban Vintage
items.text: A room built around well-worn leather, brass, and furniture from Journal Standard. A little bolder, for those who want an evening that fits the city night.
items.alt: Image of an urban-vintage room by Journal Standard

items.name: ROOM 03
items.subtitle: Industrial Modern
items.text: A room by CRASH GATE that balances rawness with comfort. Steel and brass details add a spoonful of edge to everyday living.
items.alt: Image of an industrial-modern room by CRASH GATE

moments.headingLine2: the Tokyo that lives between daily moments.

items.title: A morning with steam rising
items.text: The first cup of coffee, brewed from beans sourced at a local roaster. Window cracked open, listening to the city start to move.

items.title: A rest on the veranda
items.text: Making time to do nothing in a patch of sun. Even while traveling, letting your shoulders drop the way you would at home.

items.title: A quiet book at night
items.text: One lamp on, opening the book you brought along. A night with the sound of turning pages instead of the television.

access.description: A small, eight-room inn tucked into the backstreets of Yanaka, where the air of Tokyo's old downtown still lingers. The smell of the shopping street and the voices of neighbors are part of the stay, too.

details.label: Nearest station
details.value: 6 min walk from Nezu Station (Chiyoda Line)

access.mapAlt: Simple map illustration of the Yanaka area

footer.tagline: Live in Tokyo, even just for a stay. A small, eight-room inn in the backstreets of Yanaka.
